Fixture provenance:

- `worten_live.html`: reduced HTML from the public Worten TCL 85C7K page, retrieved 2026-10-06. Includes the original product JSON-LD and seller element. The description is irrelevant to parsing and may be removed without changing the test.
- `worten_search_live.json`: reduced response from Worten's public storefront search endpoint, retrieved 2026-10-06. Keeps canonical links and result count. The storefront returns nearby models when the exact one is absent; tests deliberately reject them.
- `darty_live.html`, `darty_search_live.json`: reduced public Darty TCL 55P8L pages retrieved 2026-10-06. Missing seller/condition are intentionally asserted as unknown.
- `worten_outlet_unavailable_live.html`, `darty_85c7k_out_of_stock_live.html`: reduced public Worten TCL 85C7K Outlet Grade A and Darty TCL 85C7K pages retrieved 2026-10-06, both unavailable. Worten's JSON-LD still says InStock while its buy box offers only availability tracking; Darty's JSON-LD says OutOfStock.
- `worten_outlet.html`, `fnac.html`, `darty.html`, `radiopopular.html`, `amazon_es.html`: synthetic contract fixtures. These test parsing branches, not live availability or production retailer coverage.

No credentials, cookies, or account data are saved. Live price assertions are fixture observations, not current-price guarantees.
- `radio_85c7l_promo_live.html`: reduced public Rádio Popular TCL 85C7L page retrieved 2026-10-07: the desktop product header (title, 2.499,99 price, TV20 promo-code bar at 1999,99, cart button), the product's `meta itemprop=price`, and one card from the "similar products" carousel whose own `itemprop` price/stock/sku (2.699,99) the generic microdata reader used to pick up first. It replaces `radio_live.html`, which had been reduced from such a card and so recorded the card's price and stock.
- `kuantokusta_85c7l_live.html`: reduced KuantoKusta TCL 85C7L page retrieved 2026-10-07 through the browser fetcher (plain requests get "Access Denied"). Keeps the page's `__NEXT_DATA__` product (id, name, brand, EAN, url, total offers) with four of its 18 offers: Chipman (lowest price but 124,99 shipping), Tek4Life, Hipermercado (lowest total, free shipping) and DARTY.
- `worten_85c7l_coupon.html`: Worten TCL 85C7L price block as pasted by the owner on 2026-10-07 (2.499,00 with "Preço com cupão" 1.999,20 and "Aplica o cupão TCL20"), plus its promo flags (TCL20, a store-credit "10% extra em talão", HOTDAYS without a shown price) and an accessory card with its own itemprop price; JSON-LD and buy box follow the live page's shape.
